Indian Navy to commission indigenous multi-purpose vessel 'Samarthak'

The Indian Navy will commission the indigenous multi-purpose vessel 'Samarthak' at the Karwar naval base on October 16, 2026. Built by L&T, it is the first such vessel manufactured in India and is designed to bolster the nation's self-reliance in the defense sector. The ship is equipped with special features and is expected to play a significant role in various naval operations at sea.
